label: Archive files to ZIP
description: Requires Python 3. Creates one ZIP beside the first selected file. Duplicate basenames inside the archive get numbered names. Set a python3 override if your installation uses python.exe.

executor.scriptBody:
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED

used_names = set()
with ZipFile(os.environ['BERGAMOT_OUTPUT'], 'w', compression=ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for path in map(Path, sys.argv[1:]):
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f'Expected a file: {path}')
        name = path.name
        number = 1
        while name.casefold() in used_names:
            name = f'{path.stem} ({number}){path.suffix}'
            number += 1
        used_names.add(name.casefold())
        archive.write(path, arcname=name)
